name: @thetis/host-update
description: Updates the installation itself from the control panel as one job on the host: download, install, build, a check that the new version loads, a rollback on any failure, then a restart or reloads of the affected workspaces. A host package: loaded by the daemon per call as host.update.<export>, never installed into a fence.

thetis.label: Thetis updates
thetis.summary: Updates Thetis itself from the Control panel.
